# Sloth Money

> Sloth Money helps couples build shared goals, budgets, and long-term money plans.

## Main pages

- [Sloth Money](https://slothmoney.app/): Product overview and pricing.
- [Developer guide](https://slothmoney.app/developers/): Agent API authentication, CLI setup, cache-only account and investment views, goal-savings account management, goal management, transaction categorization, endpoints, and safe write workflows.
- [Privacy policy](https://slothmoney.app/privacy/): How Sloth Money handles personal and financial data.

## Developer resources

- [Sloth Agent CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@slothmoney/agent-cli): Public command-line client for inspecting accounts and investment holdings, managing goal-savings membership and goals, and categorizing transactions through the Sloth Agent API.
- [Sloth Agent CLI source](https://github.com/RathBala/sloth-agent-cli): MIT-licensed source code and usage documentation.
